# Shield +3 (`magic-items:shield-3`)
**Category:** [Armor](../equipment-categories/armor.md) | **Rarity:** Very Rare | **Attunement:** No | **Variant:** Yes

Armor (Shield)

While holding this Shield, you have a +3 bonus to Armor Class, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
